result.detail: One-hop usability on the base was as good as the research graph, and coverage was 64.6% through protein and disease intermediates only, because the base had protein->phenotype but not disease->phenotype. That gap motivated the HPO port.
result.numbers: 1-hop median 104, p90 414, 92.9% under 500; coverage 9975/15430 (64.6%); intermediates protein 45890 / disease 4134
